 * Monitor collateral exposures, valuations, haircuts, and contractual requirements

 * Identify and implement opportunities for automation and optimization of existing processes

 * Actively contribute to the further development of our collateral management systems, processes, and Group-wide solutions

 * Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders, including trading desks, international Group entities, clearing houses, and custodians

 * Proficiency in MS Excel; experience with collateral management systems is a plus

Our Offer

 * Responsible role in a specialized area with direct exposure to international financial markets

 * Broad range of responsibilities combining day-to-day operational activities with analytical and strategic topics

 * Opportunity to actively shape processes and turn your own ideas into practical solutions

Join us now to be part of one of Europe's most exciting growth stories! 1 Junior Customer Success Manager (DACH) (m/f/d) Your Role

As Junior Customer Success Manager for Activation in DACH, you make sure every new German-speaking customer goes from "just signed" to "fonio picks up our calls every day". You own the first weeks of the customer journey: setting up their AI assistant, testing and fine-tuning it, and getting it live on their phone line.

You'll spend most of your time in onboarding calls with customers and inside the fonio platform. You learn how every feature works and figure out the best setup for each customer, whether that's a dental practice in Munich, a law firm in Vienna or a car workshop in Zurich.

 

What to expect

 * Run onboarding calls with new DACH customers and set up their AI assistant together with them

 * Translate each customer's business into a working setup: prompt, knowledge base, call transfers, notifications and integrations

 * Test and fine-tune assistants until they're ready to go live, so customers don't get stuck in "almost done"

 * Help customers connect their phone system and get call forwarding running

 * Follow up with customers who signed but aren't active yet, and get them over the line

 * Become a power user of the platform: learn how each feature works and which setup fits which use case

 * Bring patterns and friction points from onboardings back to Product and CS to improve templates, guides and the product

 * Hand activated customers over to Customer Success with a clean setup and clear notes

 * Track your onboardings and activation results in HubSpot

 

Who We're Looking For

 * 0-2 years of experience in a customer-facing role (onboarding, support, CS, sales, hospitality or customer service) or a strong graduate profile. Internships count.

What We Offer

 * Lunch and dinner are on us. Every day.

 * The fridge is always full: Red Bull, Mate, Cola, Almdudler and more
